scope: Source positions and optical limits for Pico interaction; each implemented surface has its own exact product acceptance record.

entries.axes: Exported product local axes, front=+Z; no guest or screen coordinates.

button.basis: Official dimension drawing: 14.64 mm from bottom of 24 mm board, 4.46 mm left of center screw.

candidateFrontHitRegion.basis: Interaction region estimate from visible cap/button mark; not yet installed or raycast accepted.

button.inspectionMembership: Any future cover-key:button hit mesh must accompany the cover inspection group; the native board-side insert remains seated.

rgb.basis: Official dimension drawing: 8.14 mm from bottom of 24 mm board; 4.56 mm left of center screw.
rgb.opticalVisibility: Applied film photograph shows a white/printed status bar. Its optical transmission/opening is unverified; opaque paper must not be perforated merely to display guest RGB.
rgb.notYetImplemented: No ledIndex/control wiring or guest behavior is added by this mechanical handoff; electrical evidence belongs to the runtime lane.
